name: Module Selection Decision Tree
description: Determines which target platform modules a customer needs based on their use case and requirements.

nodes.question: What is the primary use case?

nodes.recommendation: Core: Account Management + User Management + Territory Alignment + Visit Management
nodes.follow_up: Do reps detail products during visits?

additional_checks.question: Mobile deployment required?
additional_checks.add: DB Schema + Mobile Metadata Cache configuration

nodes.recommendation: Core: Account Management + User Management + Territory Alignment + Key Account Management
Core: Account Management + User Management + Consent Management (required for compliance)
Core: Account Management + User Management + Territory Alignment + Next Best (NBC/NBA/NBM)

Deploy in sequence: (1) Foundation: User → Territory → Account, (2) Core: Visit → Sample → Product, (3) Planning: Activity Plan → Lists, (4) Digital: Field Email → Content → Consent, (5) Advanced: Next Best → KAM → Agentforce, (6) Mobile: DB Schema → Metadata Cache → Deploy

common_combinations.modules: All core + Activity Plan + Product + Sample + Lists
Account + Field Email + Content + Consent + User
Full Field Force + Next Best + Data Cloud + Agentforce
